basis:
Rule-based checklist: baseline entry, clothing, fuel and logistics sections only. Road, mild, under-3h and no-travel selections trigger no conditional section, so the count is 4 and no conditional item is required.

Steps: ["Start with the four baseline sections: entry, clothing, fuel, logistics.", "Road adds no trail or navigation section.", "Mild weather adds no heat, cold or rain section.", "Under-3h duration adds no long-race section; no travel adds no travel section."]
Notes: Common mistake: assuming every checklist includes navigation or emergency items. On a short mild road race with no travel, only the four baseline sections apply; any extra item still follows the organiser's rules, not this list.
